name: MSG_PICKUP
meaning: attach to the sender joint (arg & 0xff); SetState(HELD), stop sound

name: MSG_QUERY_NEAREST_TARGET
meaning: while blowing, with a report <= 0x800 ticks old: *arg = {classId, proximity}, returns 1 (Wolf itemPromptId +0x660 -> HUD icon)

name: MSG_CARRY_ANIM
meaning: while blowing: arg 1 (Wolf 0x5b FAN_TURN) -> anim 1, else anim 0; LOOP|BLEND, only if not already playing

name: MSG_ATTRACT_REPORT
meaning: stores the nearest {classId, proximity} report within 0.5 s (relayed by the Perfume)
